If improvements are modest or inconsistent on small scales, flag the SOTA claim as weak.",
  "evidence_to_check": "Experimental results tables, dataset descriptions, and backbone specifications. Look for comparisons against strong baselines on large-scale datasets and consistency of performance gains across different model sizes.",
  "failure_mode": "Overstating the significance of the contribution by relying on small-scale or niche benchmarks that do not reflect the typical deployment scenarios or the true state-of-the-art in the field.",
  "why_it_matters": "Significance (SIGN-SOT) depends on demonstrating substantial and consistent improvements over strong baselines. Small-scale results may not generalize, leading to an overestimation of the work's impact and practical utility.",

}
